description: Retrospective historical-context diagnostic of the pinned published K2-18 b GO-2722 C1 spectrum; no comparison, molecular attribution, or life inference is evaluated.

program.selection_rule: Use the historical C1 G395H visit only, with both archived Eureka and exoTEDRF NRS2 views, solely as a standalone context diagnostic.
program.note: Eureka and exoTEDRF are correlated views of the same C1 photons. C1 is not pooled or voted with C2/C3.

exoTEDRF.uncertainty_rule: max(yerrLow,yerrUpp), with both reported errors required positive

Eureka.uncertainty_rule: 1000000*max(rp^2_errorneg,rp^2_errorpos), with both reported errors required positive

rebinning.grid_definition: e_k = 1 micrometre * exp(k/100) for integer k
rebinning.edge_hash_encoding: newline-joined Python float64 format(.17g), no trailing newline
rebinning.assignment: Reuse the committed GO-2372 method: W_ji is proportional to overlap_length(native_i,output_j)/sigma_i^2 and normalized per output row; y_out=W*y_native and C_out=W*C_native*W^T.
rebinning.edge_policy: Use only the unchanged global cells wholly inside 3.85-4.75 micrometres; reject partial native coverage.

analysis.label: historical C1 4.3-micrometre local contrast context
analysis.model: y = alpha + beta*(lambda-4.30) + A*f, where f is the output-bin wavelength-overlap fraction with [4.05,4.55] micrometres
analysis.primary_covariance: C_native=diag(max(error_low,error_high)^2), propagated with the unchanged W and fit by full GLS
analysis.leave_one_output_bin_out: refit the unchanged full intercept+slope+feature model after each one-bin deletion

context_rules.positive_local_contrast_in_both_correlat: both nominal views are valid with A>0 and z>=2, every rho=0.25/0.5 sensitivity is valid with A>0, and every required one-bin-deletion fit is valid with A>0

transparency.reason: The numerical method was already committed for C2/C3 and is reused unchanged, but the first few C1 table rows had been displayed while checking headers before this C1 implementation.
limitations: substantially shorter out-of-transit time baseline in C1

published spot-treatment disagreement: Hu et al. masked a C1 spot-crossing event in Eureka, while Schmidt et al. report no spot crossing in the NIRSpec light curves and treat the event as NIRISS-specific; these spectra cannot adjudicate the disagreement
the two reduction views share photons
published covariance is unavailable; diagonal and assumed native AR(1) covariances are diagnostics, not measured covariance
transparency.post_run_editorial_clarification: After the first execution, two limitation labels were made more precise and the Schmidt et al. provenance citation was added. No input, numerical method, threshold, descriptor rule, or result value changed.

allowed_claim: The historical C1 context harness reports whether the unchanged signed local 4.3-micrometre contrast criterion is met in both correlated published views; this is descriptive context only.
prohibited_claims: independent evidence from Eureka and exoTEDRF
pooling or voting C1 with C2/C3
biosignature, habitability, or evidence of life
